subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the game table in the garden

705360101.text: Hehe, Dodoco defeated lots of bad Spikey Fish Warriors! Even the Spikey Fish King was no match!

705360102.text: Dodoco, Jumpy Dumpty, and Klee's Sparks 'n' Splash are the best!

705360105.text: This game reminds Paimon of the incident happening in Cider Lake... Did Lisa base its theme on that?

705360106.text: But come to think of it, why go to the trouble of finding the invading species when they could just ask Klee to blow up every suspicious fish?

705360107.text: They could even give us some bombs and let us handle this!
